note: Every run directory under results/hpc/vanda is either selected for the report or excluded with a reason. scripts/results_io.py reads only selected runs; scripts/audit_results.py checks them.

measures.e0-align: buffer alignment 16/64/4096 bytes: serial time, hardware counters, efficiency at P <= 8
measures.e1-serial: serial scaling in N and d, kernel ladder, tile sizes, vector width, error study
measures.e1-extras: clock ramp of a short run; S1 against one rank of M0 and M2
measures.e2-strongx: strong scaling, 72 to 288 cores (four nodes), with its own serial baseline
measures.e3-single: weak scaling, ranks x threads, causal mask, GQA: configurations up to 72 cores
measures.e3-multi: the same at 288 cores; microbenchmark, few rows per rank, traces, placement
measures.e5-model: few rows per rank inside one node: thin ranks, 18-thread ranks, two-rank microbenchmark
measures.e7-hardware: no-communication control from 1 to 72 ranks with sampled clock frequency
measures.e7-memory: peak memory of all-gather, ring and one-sided variants
measures.real-data: real tensors: validation against fp64 and PyTorch, all variants, GQA against control
measures.real-e11: real tensors: attention statistics and window approximations (fp64 analysis)
measures.gpu-ladder: one GPU: kernels K0, K1, K2, causal mask, real tensors
measures.gpu-ringcheck: MPI+CUDA ring, two ranks sharing one GPU: correctness only
measures.gpu-ring-1node: MPI+CUDA ring, two GPUs in one node
measures.gpu-ring-2node: MPI+CUDA ring, one GPU in each of two nodes
measures.unit-tests: unit tests of the submitted code
measures.e5-fatcheck: repeat of three wide-rank configurations, two rounds
measures.gpu-validate: GPU unit tests: K0, K1, K2 on boundary, mask and grouped-head cases, every row against fp64
measures.e8-clock: control under perf stat (clock and work per cycle); ring exchange without computation, 2 to 72 ranks
